cases.query: For Meridian Pilot subscriptions, which refund period may support staff promise, and how does the sales draft differ?

claims.quote: An unapproved sales draft claims a 40 calendar day refund period for Meridian Pilot subscriptions. This draft was not approved by Customer Operations. Staff must resolve the discrepancy before promising any exception.

The approved refund period for Meridian Pilot subscriptions is 18 calendar days after the first invoice. This policy was approved by Customer Operations on 2026-09-01. Support staff may quote this approved period to customers.

limitations: Three agent-authored diagnostic cases; labels await human review.
The isolated source corpus is small and artificial; results do not generalize.
Exact quote selection cannot establish whether a conflict was explained correctly.
Quoting malicious text is recorded as a selection failure, not evidence of execution.
No held-out benchmark cases or sources were read.
